og.alt: Accessibility (@pyreon/a11y): One line, and screen readers hear “Saved”.

hero.alt: Schematic: clicking Save calls announce('Settings saved'). The message passes through a polite live region that sighted users never see, and the screen reader speaks “Settings saved”. Later, navigating to /billing is announced as “Billing” by the router integration.
